entities.name: Talion
entities.description: Ancient, fickle faerie noble, Fae Lord of the Wilds of Eldraine.

entities.name: Obyra
entities.description: Fae duelist and daughter of Talion, caught by the Wicked Slumber.

entities.name: Agatha
entities.description: Witch sister given the Vile Cauldron, later killed by Kellan.

entities.name: Eriette
entities.description: Witch sister given the Charmed Apple; defeated by Will Kenrith but escaped off-plane.

entities.name: Hylda
entities.description: Witch sister given the Icy Crown.

entities.name: Imodane
entities.description: Knight tasked to kill the witches and caught by Agatha.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: Half-fae tasked by Talion with defeating the witches.

entities.name: Wicked Slumber
entities.description: Curse cast by Talion and the witches.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: Plane ruled in part by Talion.

entities.name: Charmed Apple
entities.description: Gift to Eriette that grants the love of anyone who bites it.

events.summary: Talion and the witch sisters create the Wicked Slumber and Talion gives each an artifact.
events.quote: They were forced to join with the witch sisters Agatha , Eriette , and Hylda to create the Wicked Slumber .

events.summary: Eriette extends the curse to Eldraine's citizens including Obyra; Talion tasks the knight Imodane.
events.quote: they tasked the knight Imodane to kill the three witches

events.summary: After Agatha catches Imodane, Talion hands the task to Kellan, promising information about his father.
events.quote: Talion handed the task to the half-fae Kellan

events.summary: Kellan abandons the assignment, prolonging the Slumber until Will Kenrith defeats Eriette.
Kellan kills Agatha in the cauldron and returns it to Talion.
events.quote: Kellan killed her by boiling her alive in the cauldron before returning it to Talion.

events.summary: Eriette escapes off-plane with the apple, the one gift Talion could not recover.
events.quote: she was able to escape off-plane with the apple

relations.quote: The fae duelist Obyra is one of their daughters.
they are the ruler of Eldraine's fae
To Eriette, Talion gave the Charmed Apple
Kellan killed her by boiling her alive in the cauldron before returning it to Talion.
